name: move_between_my_accounts
description: Station B, B1 (flaw). Same scope and write rules as B2 (the Station A2 rule block, step for step). Wrapped API as tool: the model supplies backend account IDs, and the recipe returns the customer API's raw response body, status code and errors.

input.description: POSTs {from, to, amount, memo} to /transfers on the Dewy Bank customer API to move money between two of the signed-in customer's own accounts. Use this when the customer asks to transfer, move or send money from one of their accounts to another of their accounts. Get the accountId values from list_my_accounts first. The amount is in US dollars. Returns the customer API response body (message, from, to, amount) and HTTP status code. Add a note only if the customer asks for one; it is sent as the memo on both accounts' activity. If the transfer is refused or fails, no money was moved: explain the message to the customer instead of retrying with different values.
